text: DATAIO-026: convert() now takes columns and rename (acceptance), so tests/test_parity.py::test_every_keyword_is_a_flag_with_the_same_name[convert] fails until the CLI block adds --columns/--rename flags (out of scope here). The gate release.py --check is red only on this test; 663 others pass.
note: DATAIO-028 adds --columns/--rename and fixes test_parity; DATAIO-027 now depends on DATAIO-028 so its gate is not red on it
